summary: packaging/install.sh implements the full T20 uv-bootstrap contract per the plan: new --bootstrap-uv and --non-interactive flags with parse-time BAD_USAGE guards (pipx/uninstall), UV_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED and UV_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED shell tokens, the stdin_is_interactive/confirm_bootstrap_uv/bootstrap_uv/prepare_install_method functions wired into run_install() after checksum and before the dry-run branch, hermetic AWF_UV_INSTALLER and AWF_INSTALL_FORCE_INTERACTIVE seams, and non-mutating dry-run. Existing uv-present and pipx behavior are preserved. All 15 planned test cases exist (14 in tests/unit/installer/test_install_sh_uv_bootstrap.py plus the two new flags added to the --help DOCUMENTED_FLAGS contract test), and the harness was extended with write_uv_installer, the _stub_contents/_uv_behavior refactor, stdin input, and a PATH that drops real uv/pipx. The stdin_is_interactive ordering correctly checks --non-interactive before the force seam so the override edge (case 10) holds. Scope stayed installer-only; no Python catalog/host_setup/CLI/MCP changes. QUICKSTART.md was explicitly optional in the plan and no docs drift test references the new flags.
